description: Java class for a UI fragment handling NFC card reading in an Android app, including NFC reader mode management and account info display.

classes.name: CardReaderFragment
classes.description: A Fragment subclass managing NFC reader mode and displaying account info in an Android app.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates layout, initializes UI components, and sets up NFC reader.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Disables NFC reader mode when fragment is paused.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Enables NFC reader mode when fragment is resumed.

methods.name: enableReaderMode
methods.description: Enables NFC reader mode with specific flags.

methods.name: onAccountReceived
methods.description: Updates UI with received account info on the main thread.
